notes:
Addressed world review findings from touch resize handle implementation (Phase 4 of Mobile Touch Enhancements).

Bug fixes:
1. WCAG 2.5.8 touch target violation: EDGE_THRESHOLD_COARSE increased from 16px to 22px (half of 44px WCAG minimum). This ensures touch resize handles have at least a 44px touch target area. Test: 4.3.8 verifies hit test at 22px from edge returns edge target for touch pointerType.

2. Missing pointerleave event handler: When pointer exits canvas, hover state (and touch handle rendering) persisted because no pointermove events fire outside canvas. Added _onPointerLeave method that clears titleHoverTarget, titleInteractionPointerType, resets cursor, and schedules a render. Guard: skips if isInteracting (pointer capture still delivers events). Test: 4.3.9 verifies hover state cleared and render scheduled on pointerleave.

SOLID review: Clean. _onPointerLeave has single responsibility (clear hover state on canvas exit). No new switch/if-else chains. Handler contract unchanged. No new imports.

All 1638+ tests pass (0 failures).
